all_of.source_quote: Students are required to take their learning outside the classroom
all_of.description: Community involvement experience via internship (POSC 395) or independent project (POSC 490x), each requiring approval to enroll; Political Science majors must additionally take four courses (16 units) outside the department for a total of 22 units.
all_of.note: Approval requirement for POSC 395/490x enrollment is not independently checkable; an amendment for Political Science majors (four courses, 16 units, outside the department, total 22 units) applies to this requirement, cited at L025 and L075.
